issues.description: Default v3 speaker disagrees between docstring/PR description ('aditya') and TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS ('shubh').
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this contradiction. The module docstring and PR description advertise 'aditya' as the default v3 speaker, but TTSModelConfig sets default_speaker='shubh'. One source is wrong. Make the config the single source of truth and align the docstring before landing.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 for unknown models instead of failing.
issues.detail: Unknown or typo'd model names return the v2 speaker list as if authoritative, violating the contract that returned speakers are valid for the requested model. Callers downstream will trust a value that is not true. Raise ValueError (consistent with __init__) or return an empty list with a logged warning.

issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT connect_kwargs with no explanation.
issues.detail: The previous _connect passed input_audio_codec; the new version removes it while the field is still stored and documented on the instance. Either this is dead state or a silently changed wire contract for saarika:v2.5. Add a comment explaining the SDK change or restore the parameter.

issues.description: Silent pace clamping mutates caller input without surfacing the corrected value.
issues.detail: The PR advertises automatic clamping when pace is outside the v3 range, but conflates 'value the user asked for' with 'value sent.' Either raise on out-of-range input, return the corrected value via the API, or at minimum add a stated invariant plus a unit test so the behavior is debuggable.

issues.description: STT __init__ now rejects legacy model strings previously accepted by substring matching.
issues.detail: Switching from 'saaras' in model.lower() to a closed MODEL_CONFIGS enumeration of three keys means strings like 'saarika:v1' or future model variants raise ValueError at construction. The PR claims backward compatibility but breaks it. State the contract explicitly or widen the allowlist.

issues.description: Speaker enums and TTSModelConfig.speakers duplicate the same speaker list twice.
issues.detail: SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums exist and TTSModelConfig.speakers re-derives the same data via tuple(s.value for s in ...). The duplication is mild but invites drift. One immutable mapping {model: frozenset(speakers)} would be simpler and remove a second source of truth.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor from substring sniffing ('saaras' in model.lower()) to an explicit MODEL_CONFIGS table is the right structural move — model facts now live in one immutable data structure. However, the implementation re-introduces incidental complexity and silent behaviors: the v3 default speaker contradicts itself between code and docs, get_speakers_for_model silently fakes v2 data for unknown models, input_audio_codec disappears from the STT connect call with no comment, and pace clamping mutates caller input without surfacing it. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK. Fix the speaker mismatch, make unknown-model handling fail loudly, document or restore input_audio_codec, and make pace clamping explicit before landing.
